muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
muxt check

exec go test -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "POST /hooks Save(ctx, body)" -}}<p>{{- .Result -}}</p>{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"fmt"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type T struct{}

// Save stores a raw webhook payload it must not reinterpret; it reports the
// exact bytes it saw so the test can prove the stream reached the method.
func (T) Save(_ context.Context, body io.Reader) (string, error) {
	buf, err := io.ReadAll(body)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("len:%d:%s", len(buf), string(buf)), nil
}
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, T{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/hooks", strings.NewReader("payload-123"))
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Errorf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusOK)
	}
	if want := "<p>len:11:payload-123</p>"; rec.Body.String() != want {
		t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
	}
}
